description.zh: 经典三人斗地主。54 张牌、依次叫分抢地主、炸弹翻倍与春天结算，完整牌型（顺子、连对、飞机、四带二、王炸）。支持单人挑战电脑与同屏热座轮换对战，内置出牌提示、记牌器与托管。
description.en: Classic three-player Dou Dizhu with 54 cards, bidding for the landlord role, bomb multipliers and the spring bonus. Full pattern set - straights, consecutive pairs, planes, four-with-two and the rocket. Play solo against the CPU or pass the device between friends, with hints, a card counter and autoplay.

controls.zh: 点击选牌，再点「出牌」；也可以用「提示」自动选牌
controls.en: Tap cards to select, then Play. Use Hint to auto-select.
